analysis:
Examined all supplied source, patches and file metadata against the indexed threat model and selected detailed evidence. ClusterSetupWizardCommand.swift:116 adds an awaited waitlist check before settings, stores, services and children are constructed. Lines 140–158 bind feature 'cluster', terminal confirmation and deliberate exemptions for local-only serving and existing pairings. These exemptions do not independently establish a serving-authorization bypass: adversarial-provider authorization remains platform-owned (A-016, TB-011, T-052/T-053), and the supplied evidence does not show waitlist approval replacing it.
Darkbloom.swift:60 registers Waitlist as a new CLI command; the rest of the supplied base/head behavior is unchanged, including model selection and weight-hash handling. Sandbox/SandboxCommand.swift:28–31 changes help only; installer execution, add-on invocation, availability controls and billing behavior are unchanged in this file (TB-012/TB-013, T-059–T-061). No changed encryption, cache scoping, attestation or plaintext handling was observed (A-001/A-003, T-008, T-041).
No concrete regression is supported locally. Integration must examine Waitlist, FeatureWaitlistAccess.live and FeatureWaitlistGate.require, absent here, for credential destination/redirect handling (A-008), bounded network waits (A-018), approval-response validation and refusal before side effects. Also reconcile ClusterPairSummary.local().paired semantics—including unreadable pairing state—with the intended grandfathering policy, alternate setup entry points and sandbox setup enforcement. The new local onboarding gate must not be represented as coordinator serving authorization. Missing implementations are coverage limits, not evidence of missing controls.
